model.telemetry.dim_date.description: Calendar dimension (UTC days), generated with dbt_utils.date_spine.
model.telemetry.dim_date.name: dim_date

device_id.description: Natural device id, e.g. dev-000001. Not unique here: one row per firmware window.
device_id.name: device_id

device_key.description: Surrogate primary key of a device version (one per validity window).
device_key.name: device_key

firmware_version.description: Firmware version running during this window.
firmware_version.name: firmware_version

hardware_model.description: Hardware model: TX-100, TX-200 or TX-300.
hardware_model.name: hardware_model

install_date.description: Date the device was installed in the vehicle.
install_date.name: install_date

is_current.description: True for the device's latest known firmware window.
is_current.name: is_current

valid_from.description: Start of the window (inclusive): first event on this firmware; install date for the first version.
valid_from.name: valid_from

valid_to.description: End of the window (exclusive); 9999-12-31 for the current row.
valid_to.name: valid_to

model.telemetry.dim_device.description: SCD Type 2 device dimension, built from the dim_device_snapshot snapshot. One row per device per firmware validity window [valid_from, valid_to). Join facts "as of" event time with `event_ts >= valid_from and event_ts < valid_to`; use `is_current` for the device's present state.
model.telemetry.dim_device.name: dim_device

firmware_version.description: Primary key, semantic version string such as 1.1.0.
firmware_version.name: firmware_version

is_latest.description: True for the most recently released version.
is_latest.name: is_latest

release_date.description: Date the version was released to the fleet (start of its rollout).
release_date.name: release_date

model.telemetry.dim_firmware.description: Firmware dimension. One row per firmware version.
model.telemetry.dim_firmware.name: dim_firmware

avg_temp_c.description: Average board temperature over the day's drive minutes.
avg_temp_c.name: avg_temp_c

device_key.description: FK to dim_device: the device version live at the end of the device's day.
device_key.name: device_key

drive_minutes.description: Minutes with ignition on (rows in fct_device_minute).
drive_minutes.name: drive_minutes

firmware_changed.description: The device ran more than one firmware version that day (it upgraded).
firmware_changed.name: firmware_changed

firmware_version.description: Firmware on that day (the last version the device ran that day).
firmware_version.name: firmware_version

gps_valid_pct.description: Minutes with `fix_valid = true` / drive minutes * 100. Null when the device did not drive.
gps_valid_pct.name: gps_valid_pct

lte_loss_pct.description: Minutes with `registered = false OR ip_assigned = false` / drive minutes * 100. Null when the device did not drive that day.
lte_loss_pct.name: lte_loss_pct

max_temp_c.description: Maximum board temperature over the day's drive minutes.
max_temp_c.name: max_temp_c

model.telemetry.fct_device_daily.description: Aggregate fact at device x day grain (UTC days). A device-day exists when the device had at least one drive minute or one device event that day.
model.telemetry.fct_device_daily.name: fct_device_daily

device_key.description: FK to dim_device, as of event_ts.
device_key.name: device_key

model.telemetry.fct_device_event.description: Fact with one row per device event (crash, reboot, alarm, firmware update).
model.telemetry.fct_device_event.name: fct_device_event

device_key.description: FK to dim_device: the device version live at this minute (as-of join).
device_key.name: device_key

device_minute_id.description: Surrogate primary key (hash of device_id and minute_ts).
device_minute_id.name: device_minute_id

firmware_version.description: Firmware reported by the samples of this minute.
firmware_version.name: firmware_version

fix_valid.description: GPS fix was valid this minute.
fix_valid.name: fix_valid

ip_assigned.description: LTE data session had an IP address during this minute's sample.
ip_assigned.name: ip_assigned

lte_lost.description: True when `registered = false OR ip_assigned = false` (connectivity lost this minute).
lte_lost.name: lte_lost

minute_ts.description: UTC minute (timestamp truncated to the minute).
minute_ts.name: minute_ts

registered.description: LTE modem registered on the network during this minute's sample.
registered.name: registered

model.telemetry.fct_device_minute.description: Fact at device x minute grain for minutes with ignition on (the device was driving). Joins the heartbeat, LTE and GPS samples of that minute. A "drive minute" is one row here.
model.telemetry.fct_device_minute.name: fct_device_minute

crash_count.description: CAM_CRASH events produced by this firmware on this model that day.
crash_count.name: crash_count

device_count.description: Distinct devices that drove on this firmware and model that day.
device_count.name: device_count

device_days.description: Device-days on this firmware and model (a device that upgraded mid-day counts once per version).
device_days.name: device_days

mean_lte_loss_pct.description: Mean of the per-device-day lte_loss_pct (see fct_device_daily) on this firmware and model.
mean_lte_loss_pct.name: mean_lte_loss_pct

model.telemetry.fct_firmware_daily.description: Aggregate fact at firmware_version x hardware_model x day grain: how healthy each firmware is on each model. Use it for "before vs after the 1.1.0 upgrade" questions.
model.telemetry.fct_firmware_daily.name: fct_firmware_daily

device_key.description: FK to dim_device, as of trip start.
device_key.name: device_key

distance_km.description: Odometer difference between trip_end and trip_start, km.
distance_km.name: distance_km

duration_min.description: Minutes from trip_start to trip_end; null when the trip is incomplete.
duration_min.name: duration_min

is_complete.description: Both trip_start and trip_end were loaded.
is_complete.name: is_complete

trip_date.description: UTC date the trip started (or ended, if its start is not loaded).
trip_date.name: trip_date

model.telemetry.fct_trip.description: Fact with one row per trip (ignition on to ignition off).
model.telemetry.fct_trip.name: fct_trip

model.telemetry.stg_device_event.description: Typed device events from silver. One row per device_event.
model.telemetry.stg_device_event.name: stg_device_event

model.telemetry.stg_firmware_releases.description: Firmware versions and release dates from the OTA export.
model.telemetry.stg_firmware_releases.name: stg_firmware_releases

model.telemetry.stg_fleet_registry.description: Provisioned devices from the fleet registry export.
model.telemetry.stg_fleet_registry.name: stg_fleet_registry

model.telemetry.stg_gps.description: Typed GNSS fixes from silver. One row per gps_fix event.
model.telemetry.stg_gps.name: stg_gps

minute_ts.description: event_ts truncated to the minute; join key for fct_device_minute.
minute_ts.name: minute_ts

model.telemetry.stg_heartbeat.description: Typed heartbeat samples from silver. One row per heartbeat event.
model.telemetry.stg_heartbeat.name: stg_heartbeat

ip_assigned.description: Modem has an IP address (data session up).
ip_assigned.name: ip_assigned

registered.description: Modem registered on the cellular network.
registered.name: registered

model.telemetry.stg_lte.description: Typed LTE modem samples from silver. One row per lte_sample event.
model.telemetry.stg_lte.name: stg_lte

model.telemetry.stg_trip.description: One row per trip, pairing trip_start and trip_end.
model.telemetry.stg_trip.name: stg_trip

category.description: Subsystem the code belongs to (camera, system, thermal, firmware, storage).
category.name: category

event_code.description: Primary key. Code reported by the device, e.g. CAM_CRASH.
event_code.name: event_code

seed.telemetry.dim_event_code.description: Dimension of device event codes (seed). One row per event_code.
seed.telemetry.dim_event_code.name: dim_event_code

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for local-time questions (trips follow local daytime).
timezone.name: timezone

seed.telemetry.dim_region.description: Dimension of operating regions (seed). One row per region_id.
seed.telemetry.dim_region.name: dim_region

snapshot.telemetry.dim_device_snapshot.description: SCD2 snapshot of device firmware. Read through the dim_device model.
snapshot.telemetry.dim_device_snapshot.name: dim_device_snapshot
